problem: The function $y(t)$ gives the position of a particle at time $t>0.$ Which of the following equations represents a situation in which the particle is undergoing forced harmonic motion without damping?

feedback.problem: The function $y(t)$ gives the position of a particle at time $t>0.$ Which of the following equations represents a situation in which the particle is undergoing forced harmonic motion without damping?
feedback.worked_solution:
The general equation of forced harmonic motion without damping is

$$
{y}^{″}+{\omega }^{2}y=f(t).
$$

We can see that the only equation that represents forced harmonic motion without damping is

$$
{y}^{″}+25y=4{t}^{2}.
$$
